title: A non-business Page resolves everywhere, and holding several is ordinary

criteria.text: A non-business Page's public URL renders its name, description, image and what is filed under it instead of 404
criteria.note: [V] /g/<id> uses resolvePageById and resolveShop, which take no kind filter (T156, #174; no Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 9dde664). Smoked: unknown, smoke-live opens the first Page Explore lists and does not pick a non-business one. unmarked: src/lib/groups/resolve-shop.test.ts ('a non-business Page carries its own name and description')

criteria.text: Products, services and gatherings filed under a non-business Page resolve at their public URL
criteria.note: [V] gatherings: resolve-gathering.ts has no kind filter (built half). Products and services: resolve-product.ts:116 and resolve-service.ts:98 still filter groups on kind='business', so they 404 under any other Page [A] reachable since #363 lets any Page turn on Products & services. Tickets #22 (T134) and #591 (gathering half only)

criteria.text: A member holding several Pages sees every one on any producer surface; none chosen for them
criteria.note: [V] getOwnPages lists every founded or managed Page on /you (limit 50); Create starts a new draft and chooses nothing. First built in f19adc6, a direct commit with no PR and no deploy-health run (runs start 2026-09-16); later edits #181, #254, #389, #424, #472 carry no Reviewed by except #472. Smoked: unknown, the smoke accounts do not hold several Pages. unmarked: src/lib/member/own-pages.test.ts

criteria.text: Draft-resume keeps every in-flight draft, not just the most recent
criteria.note: [V] 'Unfinished Pages' on You lists every draft with Continue and Delete (#516, Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 0e3b4bd). unmarked: OwnPages.test.tsx '#463 — Unfinished Pages' (one draft in the fixture, not several). Check ticket #846
